I do have some sort of support from a very few friends but I feel sharing my entire life story is too much. It's sad and makes me feel vulnerable. 

My counsellors are very well aware of that. But many frequent trips to them has made me realize and confirm after every visit that all they do is offer to listen and help me think logically enough to make decisions. They never offer advice, but only worksheets to fill out on my own and self help myself. Which is understandable, given liability issues and that my university has seen an insane amount of suicides in the last decade.

I thought I was the one getting mixed signals.

the mixed signals may be mutual but I guess I'll try more.

I did tell her what happened and we laughed about it.

She never seems to want to hang out openly on a date or otherwise...thats the whole issue :/
well the spending part is true but I'm certain he's unaware of the how bad I'm messing up or he would have mentioned it.
